name: Jobby
storyline: Welcome to the corporate battlefield, where qualifications are meaningless and words are stolen property! In Jobby, players enter a cutthroat hiring process where their vocabulary is completely at the mercy of their competitors. After answering initial icebreaker questions, candidates watch as their original responses are harvested into a shared pool of snippets. To tackle the upcoming job interview rounds, applicants must construct clever, absurd, or completely unhinged answers using only the stolen words provided by other players. Craft the ultimate response, complete a chaotic resume, and convince the board that you are the uniquely unqualified candidate for the job.
